# Land of Stone Flowers
> Illustrated book by Sveta Dorosheva. Published by Chronicle Books (USA), Азбука (RU), マール社 (JP).

## About
"The Land of Stone Flowers: A Fairy Guide to the Mythical Human Being" is an illustrated book by
Ukrainian-Israeli artist Sveta Dorosheva. Originally published in Russian as «Книга, найденная в кувшинке»
(Издательство Азбука). The English edition is published by Chronicle Books (ISBN 978-1-4521-6370-3).

The book consists of illustrated fables told from the perspective of fairy-folk — gnomes, pixies, and other
magical beings — who observe humans with curiosity and dry wit. Hand-drawn, highly decorative folk art style
with dense ornamental detail. Poetic narrative. Suitable for adults and older children.

## Languages & Publishers
- English: Chronicle Books (USA) — ISBN 978-1-4521-6370-3
- Russian: Издательство Азбука (RU)
- Japanese: マール社 (JP)
- Also published in: Romanian, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)

## Artist
Sveta Dorosheva — illustrator and artist. Born in Ukraine. Based in Israel.
Internationally published in 7 languages. Works in narrative illustration, editorial illustration,
and art for books. Style often compared to Aubrey Beardsley; draws on Eastern European folk art traditions
and medieval manuscript illumination.
Portfolio: https://svetadorosheva.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sveta.dorosheva/
